item.description:
PalMeet 0.2.6

  • Google Meet: speakers are named from the speaking highlight on their tile (the moving voice bars), even with captions off. Update the PalMeet extension in Chrome (it reloads itself) to get this.
  • Meet's "Are you talking? Your mic is off." is no longer read as a person called "Are you". Voices learned under such names are removed.
  • Your own tile is ignored when naming remote speakers, and captions win over the highlight.
  • Review → Regenerate → "Transcribe again from the audio" redoes a meeting's transcript and summary.

PalMeet 0.2.5

  • Meeting audio is compressed (about 6× smaller) once the meeting is transcribed and summarized; existing meetings are converted once. Choose Lossless or Original in Settings → Privacy → Recordings.
  • "Delete audio after" counts from when PalMeet saved the meeting (an imported old video keeps its audio for the full period) and also runs while PalMeet stays open.

PalMeet 0.2.4

  • Meeting audio is now compressed (about 6× smaller) once the meeting is transcribed and summarized. Your existing meetings are converted once in the background. Choose Lossless or Original in Settings → Privacy → Recordings.
  • "Delete audio after" now also runs while PalMeet stays open for days.
